item.title: Possible Bikes for Dale: stepthrough, under 50 pounds, removable battery :-), rack, lights,
item.description:
• Draft created: Nov 27, 2026 13:18 (UTC).
  • generated by my friend G :-) and really much less frustrating than surfing the bicycle manufacturer’s and bike shops terrible websites
  • not blaming bike shop and bike manufacturers :-) this is yet another failure of “Software Engineering” making unusable software for maintaining websites and adding new content to websites
  • I personally would just YOLO and buy the Tern but #Ymmv LOL. I am not in the market for an e-bike though. Quite happy with my ‘fleet’ of acoustic bicycles

The following was not written by me LOL

At 5’6” and a strict $3,500 CAD budget (including taxes), the Kona Ecoco is the clear winner—especially when purchased on sale, which leaves plenty of room for BC’s 12% combined PST/GST and a bolt-on rear rack.

Side-by-Side Comparison (Tailored for 5’6” & $3,500 CAD Tax-In)

Feature Kona Ecoco (Best Fit & Value) Norco Scene VLT (Over Budget at MSRP) Tern Vektron Q9 (Over Budget)
Brand Heritage Kona (Founded 1988 — 38 yrs) Norco (Founded 1964 — 62 yrs) Tern (Founded 2011; Dahon lineage 1982)
Recommended Size (5’6”) Small or Medium (Sits right on the cusp; S for upright/easy reach, M for longer leg extension) Small (Fits ~5’2”–5’7”) One Size Fits All (Fits riders 4’10”–6’5”)
Weight 43.0 lbs (19.5 kg) ~36–48 lbs (depending on build) 48.3 lbs (21.9 kg)
Removable Battery Yes — 504 Wh Shimano (ABUS lock) Yes — 504 Wh Shimano (keyed lock) Yes — 400 Wh Bosch PowerPack
Motor Shimano Mid-Drive (EP500 / E6100) Shimano STEPS EP6 Mid-Drive (85 Nm) Bosch Active Line Plus Mid-Drive (50 Nm)
Fenders Included (Full-wrap) Not included (Mounts ready) Included (SKS fenders)
Lights Included (Front & rear integrated) Included (Front & rear integrated) Included (Front & rear integrated)
Rear Rack Not included (Frame eyelets ready; ~$60–$90 aftermarket) Not included (Frame eyelets ready; ~$60–$90 aftermarket) Included (Atlas V Rack, 60 lb capacity)
Canadian Price (Before Tax) $2,475 – $2,640 CAD (Sale) / $3,299 CAD (MSRP) $3,699 CAD (MSRP) / ~$3,400 CAD (Sale) $4,199 – $4,649 CAD
Est. Total w/ 12% BC Tax ~$2,772 – $2,957 CAD (Sale) / ~$3,695 CAD (MSRP) ~$4,143 CAD (MSRP) / ~$3,808 CAD (Sale) ~$4,703 – $5,207 CAD
Fits $3,500 Tax-In Budget? Yes (When bought on current Canadian closeout/sale pricing) No (Exceeds $3,500 once 12% tax is added) No (Well over $3,500 before tax)

Key Takeaways for Your Setup

  • Best Overall Choice: Look for a Kona Ecoco (Size Small or Medium) on sale through Canadian dealers (such as PRFO Sports or Skiis & Biikes, currently listing around $2,475–$2,640 CAD). Even after adding 12% BC tax (~$300), a lightweight aluminum rear rack (~$75), and shipping/PDI (~$150), your total lands around $3,000–$3,200 CAD—comfortably under $3,500 while keeping total bike weight around 44.5 lbs.
  • Sizing Tip at 5’6”: Because 5’6” sits right on the overlap between Kona’s Small (5’2”–5’7”) and Medium (5’6”–5’10”), Size Small is generally preferred on a step-through commuter for a shorter reach to the swept-back handlebars and easier flat-footed stops.

Hailed as ‘biggest breakthrough in decades ¦ The Guardian
item.description:
Discovered: Nov 21, 2026 15:49 (UTC) Helena Horton:: A year after starting treatment with daraxonrasib, 76.6% of pancreatic cancer patients were alive; usually 40-45% of patients given chemotherapy alone survive a year.Pancreatic cancer undetectable for one in 12 patients in trial. Hailed as ‘biggest breakthrough in decades ¦ The Guardian <– Go Science go!

With the previously announced trail of the mRNA vaccine against KRAS and a custom mRNA vaccine, more and more progress against pancreatic cancer, yes!

Previously

  • April 19, 2026: ME:: tl;dr-ing if your pancreatic cancer is operable, a custom mRNA vaccine using the tumor cells removed during your operation appears to work in a small 16 person trial AND there is also an off-the-shelf vaccine that targets a protein called KRAS ; Kaitlin Sullivan, Marina Kopf, Anne Thompson:: Pancreatic cancer mRNA vaccine shows lasting results in an early trial
  • August 1, 2020: Please consider donating to my team, Sofia’s Camera Club, for the virtual Cypress Challenge in honour of my mother who died of Pancreatic Cancer in 2013. 100% of your donations go to pancreatic cancer; this is a zero overhead ride

QUOTE

  • Read the whole thing: Pill to treat pancreatic cancer hailed as ‘biggest breakthrough in decades’ ¦ Pancreas cancer ¦ The Guardian

In one in 12 of the patients given the drug, daraxonrasib, during a trial, the cancer became undetectable, and the tumours stopped growing in almost all of the 61 patients. The trial participants had recently been diagnosed with advanced pancreatic cancer that had spread to other parts of the body.

Though doctors have said the pill cannot yet be considered a cure, and they do not know how long it can keep the disease at bay, they have said it is encouraging news because it appears it will offer patients more time, even if it does not cause full remission.
